~991 GLBs / 1.6 GB — link index, not mirrored

3,391 GLBs — attribution required
registry contract / base components
runtime dependency, not catalogue items

5 CC0 GLSL fragment shaders copied into website/shaders
Embedded glTF tutorial primitives, CC0 per README
